r_on.source: assumption: demand/capacity at which add_reserve triggers

r_off.source: assumption: ratio below which remove_train triggers

holidays_2026.source: assumption: RF production calendar 2026 (May 9 Sat holiday, May 11 transferred day off)

od_transfer_factor.source: assumption, uncalibrated: transfer passengers are not in turnstile counts; multiplies origin entries and attraction

mock_demo_surge.source: mock, demo only: multiplies mock q50 entries so the demo shows all three load bands

sim_run_min_rule.source: derived: uniform run time per segment, no per-segment data; assumption, uncalibrated

sim_arrival_step_min.source: assumption: slot demand spread evenly over 1-min arrival steps

policy_reserve_delay_min.source: assumption: organizers give 15-20 min to enter the line; upper bound taken

policy_action_window_min.source: assumption: validity window of a mock policy recommendation

policy_headway_window_min.source: assumption: half-width of the window in which departures are counted against the min-headway rate

policy_shift_lookahead_min.source: assumption: shift_peak pulls a trip from this far after the window end

trip_km.source: derived: MO-1 Q3 2026 2 041 527 train-km / 74 299 trains, docs/data_notes.md:36

team_intrahour_split.value: mean station x day_type x hour x quarter share, same share for q10/q50/q90/baseline
team_intrahour_split.source: assumption: split of person 2 hourly quantiles by Deniskish/metro-petersburg@2f0fd0a data/reference/intrahour_profile.csv

team_forecast_missing_station.value: history percentiles by station x MSK slot x day_type (mock_forecast), model_version no_data
team_forecast_missing_station.source: assumption: stations absent from person 2 serve output (e.g. tekhnologichesky_institut at 2f0fd0a)
